findings.detail: 'row_factory' is Py_INCREF'd via Py_INCREF() with no NULL guard, but it can be NULL via a __new__/subclass bypass of tp_init (T.__new__(T) leaves it NULL). A guard such as 'row_factory != Py_None' or 'Py_IsNone(row_factory)' does NOT protect this — after the bypass the field is NULL. Add 'if (row_factory == NULL)' (or initialize it in tp_new) before the deref.
